headline: French Bond Sell-Off Serves as Warning for Global Governments
summary: Recent market sell-offs in French government bonds highlight growing fiscal concerns and debt sustainability risks that could act as a warning for other global economies.
why: Sovereign bond yields reflect market confidence in a country's fiscal management; rising yields increase government borrowing costs and signal fiscal stress.

impacts.name: French government bonds
impacts.why: A bond sell-off leads to falling bond prices and rising yields.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Selling pressure on French sovereign debt directly pushes bond prices down and yields higher as investors demand a greater risk premium.
